title: Merkle-less Sync
tagline: Compare four state-replication strategies by expected verification and update cost under adversarial changes.

curves.label: Blind Snapshot
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++) verifyStateItem(i); // no proofs, full resync when changed
curves.name: Blind Snapshot

curves.label: Differential Patch
curves.code: diff = computeDiff(local, remote); for (let k=0;k<diff.length;k++) applyPatch(diff[k]); verifyPatch(diff);
curves.name: Differential Patch

curves.label: Random Linear Checks
curves.code: pickRandomCoeffs(); lhs = dot(coeffs, local); rhs = dot(coeffs, remote); verify(lhs === rhs);
curves.name: Random Linear Checks

curves.label: Segmented MAC Tree
curves.code: segments = partition(state); for (seg of segments) updateMAC(seg); verifyChangedSegments(segmentsChanged);
curves.name: Segmented MAC Tree

curves.label: Hot-Spot Rekeying
curves.code: hot = detectHotRegions(state); for (r of hot) rekeyRegion(r); verifyRekey(r); // worst-case grows quadratically
curves.name: Hot-Spot Rekeying
